reactor_type: hot-wall flow-type ALD reactor (SUNALE R75, Picosun, Finland)
evidence: The pulsing times were 0:1 s for TMA, 0:5 s for TiOP , and 2 s for H 2Oo rH 2O2 with N 2 as carrier gas at a flow rate of 200 sccm (sccm denotes cubic centimeters per minute at standard temperature and pressure). The purging time after each pulse was set to 4 s.
